beats.title: First exception: ₹60,000, vendor certificate expired 6 days ago (no precedent yet)

request.justification: Bearing housings for the assembly line, regular item. Deccan has supplied for 2 yrs, never late.
request.email_thread:
From: sales@deccanbearings
Our ISO 9001 renewal audit is done; the new certificate will reach you next week.

decision.rationale: A recently expired certificate is a hold, not a rejection, when the vendor is otherwise in good standing: the renewal audit is done and the delivery record is clean.
decision.outcome: Hold the PO until the renewed certificate arrives; keep the vendor active.

beats.title: One week later: a different vendor, the same problem (tentative, 1 precedent)
